title: Worker report counts the intended red-at-base check as a failing check
body: Outcome: krn worker start/send exit 0 when the driver's own acceptance checks pass and the only non-zero entry in report.json checks is the brief's step-1 red-at-base run of the declared observer. Evidence: #211 round 1 printed 'report done with failing check node --test test/claude/memory-refs.test.ts exit 1', exit 4, while result.json acceptance showed check and observer exit 0 (.krn/runs/lead/memory-refs/rounds/).
